title: Shrimp Tacos
subtitle: Quick-fried prawns with mango slaw and chipotle mayo
excerpt: Raw prawns tossed in a cumin and smoked paprika spice mix and fried fast in a hot pan, served in warm corn tortillas with a sweet mango slaw and a sharp chipotle mayo. Ready in 20 minutes.
sourceNotes: Tex-Mex shrimp (prawn) tacos: a US coastal and home-cooking staple. Recipe based on classic Tex-Mex and Baja California-influenced American cooking traditions.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The mango slaw and chipotle mayo can be made up to a day ahead. Season the prawns just before cooking.

content.text: Shrimp tacos are warm corn tortillas filled with quick-fried spiced prawns, a fresh mango slaw, and chipotle mayo. Prawns cook in under 3 minutes in a very hot pan; the skill is in knowing when to stop. Overcooked prawns go rubbery, so take them off the moment they turn pink and curl.
A cast-iron skillet or a very hot frying pan is best for the prawns. The mango slaw adds sweetness and crunch; it comes together in a bowl while the prawns rest at room temperature.
Make the slaw and chipotle mayo
Toss the mango, shredded cabbage, and coriander together in a bowl. Squeeze over the lime juice, season with salt, and mix. Set aside.
Mix the chipotle into the mayonnaise with a pinch of salt. Set aside.
Pat the prawns dry. Toss with the cumin, smoked paprika, chilli flakes if using, olive oil, and a good pinch of salt.

Heat a cast-iron skillet or frying pan over high heat until very hot. Add the prawns in a single layer. Cook for 1.5-2 minutes on each side until pink and just curled. Remove immediately; they finish cooking off the heat.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill each with mango slaw, then the prawns, then a drizzle of chipotle mayo. Serve with lime wedges.

items.cause: Overcooked; prawns were left in the pan too long
items.fix: Prawns need 1.5-2 minutes a side in a very hot pan. Pull them the moment they turn pink. They carry residual heat and will firm up slightly off the pan.

items.cause: Pan not hot enough, or too many prawns crowded in at once
items.fix: The pan must be very hot before the prawns go in. Cook in two batches if needed so every prawn sits in a single layer.

items.cause: Mango very ripe and juicy, or dressed too far in advance
items.fix: Dress the slaw just before serving. If the mango is very soft, reduce the amount slightly or use firmer, slightly underripe mango.
Use 3-4 prawns per taco. Warm the tortillas until flexible before filling.

content.text: Prawn tacos follow the same logic as fish tacos: hot, well-seasoned protein, cold crunchy topping, warm tortilla. They're faster than the battered fish version and suit a weeknight pace. The mango slaw is a nod to tropical coastal cooking that crossed into US Tex-Mex as the cuisine's reach grew beyond the Southwest.
